result.summary: Analyzed the food delivery app page for visual defects. Found 1 major issue related to text clipping on a restaurant card in the carousel.

issues.description: The name of the third restaurant in the 'Fastest near you' carousel (Smash Bros Bu...) is truncated by the right screen edge instead of wrapping or being fully visible in its accessible view.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the card width or layout to ensure the restaurant name is fully visible, or add an ellipsis to indicate truncation while keeping the text accessible, or allow horizontal scrolling to reveal the full text clearly.
